name: Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre
summary: Tallinn music academy with four English-taught bachelor's (classical performance, composition, jazz, sound engineering); EU tuition €1,750 a year.

ib.text: No IB points or subjects are asked. Entry is by audition or portfolio plus interview; you upload your diploma with grades and proof of English.

programmes.name: Classical Music Performance
programmes.about: Classical and contemporary performance on keyboard, string, wind, brass and percussion instruments, voice or choral conducting, with individual lessons, chamber music, orchestral study and an opera staged each year.
programmes.ib: Entry is by a 20-30 minute audition and interview; the audition programme depends on your instrument or voice.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition on your instrument or voice, then an interview that also checks your English; scored 0-10. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Composition and Multimedia
programmes.about: Classical composition alongside music technology and multimedia: electroacoustic music, live electronics, video and installation art, with workshops, projects and the yearly COMMUTE Festival.
programmes.ib: Send two original compositions and a portfolio; expect listening tests, improvisation, a piano sight-reading test and an interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Compositions and portfolio, then listening tests, improvisation and an oral interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Sound Engineering and Music Production
programmes.about: A fine arts programme in music production, songwriting and professional recording, covering studio and live recording of classical and non-classical music with artistic and technical training.
programmes.ib: Send a motivation letter and a portfolio; if preselected you pass two listening tests and an interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Letter and portfolio (possible preselection), two listening tests, then an interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Jazz Music
programmes.about: Jazz and improvisation studied in ensembles, with individual development at the centre and international courses most years; the school belongs to the International Association of Schools of Jazz.
programmes.ib: Audition with improvised jazz pieces, sight reading, an ear-training test and a short colloquium.
programmes.selectionNote: Two improvised pieces, sight reading, ear training and a short colloquium; scored 0-10. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Its admissions page says information about next year's admissions will be published in December 2026; the audition and deadlines are not yet set.
You can audition by sending a video if you cannot travel, but the panel accepts it only if it has no doubts about authenticity.
The application fee is €75, and you may apply for up to two main subjects.
